messages:
maria: Quick profiler dump from yesterday's dedicated run (4x A100, TP=2 PP=2). Seeing odd kvcache fetch spikes during step 1200. Anyone free to sanity-check?
ryan: Can you paste the nccl timeline + flamegraph?
maria: pasted snapshot (short):
```
step:1200 seq=512 batch=8
compute: 45%
nccl_allreduce: 28% (stall on recv)
kvcache_fetch: 18% (cross-device)
other: 9%
```
maria: Note we switched default attention kernel to fused-attn v2 in PR#4024 last night. Could be related.
jess: If TP splits weights, kvcache layout matters. Are we striping KV by TP or replicating?
tao: Current config: TP sharding for weights, KV is sharded along TP axis (to save memory). PP stages hold resident activations but not all KV.
ryan: That's likely the issue — PP boundary forces remote KV fetches across GPU when a token belongs to KV shard on other TP partition. All-reduce waiting shows due to rendezvous for KV gather.
jess: Two obvious levers: replicate KV in DP within each PP stage (costly mem), or move to PP-local shard (shard by pipeline stage). Or change batching so prefixes likely hit same shard.
maria: Quick experiment idea: run a mini-benchmark with DP=2, TP=2, PP=1 (i.e., co-locate shards) and compare NCCL stall. Also try changing kernel back to fused-attn v1 to check regression.
perf-bot: note: nightly perf test "kv_shard_latency" showed +12% tail latency on fused-attn v2 at seq=512 (r:2025-03-02)
tao: Batching heuristics: grouping by prefix hash lowered cross-shard fetches by ~40% in sim. Maybe implement soft-affinity in batcher: prefer to pack requests that share initial token hashes so they hit same KV shard.
ryan: Also look at comm/compute overlap. Our runtime does not start KV fetch until layer N compute finishes. Could we start async prefetch earlier? There's risk of cache churn.
jess: Kernel selection angle: fused-attn v2 uses different memory layout for KV (packed), which breaks our existing kvcache prefetch path -> extra memcpy and page faults. That could explain sudden spike.
maria: Action items:
- ryan: run DP=2 vs replicate-KV microbenchmark and post nccl timelines (due EOD)
- tao: prototype batching affinity change (small flag) and simulate
- jess: try downgrading kernel in container to v1 to isolate regression
- perf-bot: create perf ticket linking PR#4024
ryan: ack. I'll capture nvprof + NCCL trace and share short TL;DR.
jess: FYI if we replicate KV per PP stage we save NCCL but add mem ~model_size/PP. With 8k sequence windows it's nontrivial.
maria: If replication cost too high, maybe hybrid: shard by TP within stage but replicate hot KV slices (top-k most accessed prefixes). Could be small memory win.
tao: Interesting — implement an LRU "replicate-on-hot" policy for kvcache; runtime needs counters per-shard. Overhead low if we sample.
maria: thanks all. Will sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup: 
ryan: bump tomorrow sync pls if anyone can't make.
perf-bot: ticket PERF-1129 created: "kv-shard-regression-post-fused-attn-v2" linked to PR#4024
maria: closing loop — saving traces to /obs/runs/1797654321/ and pinned on the doc.
